width2_gate_audit.qualification: The reported metadata-occupancy gate is numerically true but its producer assertion is vacuous because occupancy is clamped with min(16,len(ready)) before checking <=16.

performance_decomposition.causal_interpretation: Wider descriptor admission changes which ready K6 tasks coexist and are fused. W2 reduces fusion groups by 204296 and source cycles by 109080, but earlier/burstier residency shifts pressure to the context/complete path: response wait rises 116984 and parent wait rises 27160. Those increases consume most of the source and command savings. W4 intensifies the same coupling and is slower than W2.

static_source_audit.descriptor_count_derivation: 40 records * 10 timesteps * 27 tiles * 300 descriptors * 8 output blocks = 25920000
static_source_audit.reason: The model changes only a software command-calendar capacity. It does not carry payload/address bytes, enforce 128/256-byte alignment or transfer, emit per-lane valid and packet membership, model a bounded packet assembly queue, or charge unpack/dispatch/backpressure/wide-wire timing, area, and energy.

go: Exact W1 reproduction of M89 K6 aggregate and all ten per-sample source/integrated cycles
W2 packet-calendar lane utilization 0.583652751 and W4 utilization 0.294999217 as bookkeeping ratios
no_go: Relaxing the frozen 0.5 percent integrated-cycle promotion threshold
Reporting the 0.1559 percent W2 source reduction as performance
Calling the calendar a functionally or temporally verified 128/256-byte packet path
RTL/VCS cycle speedup or equal-area/equal-power advantage
DATE headline, best-paper, or external-accelerator superiority claim

findings.finding: M93 replaces only command_port's calendar class. Descriptor bytes and packet capacity are ledger constants; no payload/address, alignment, lane-valid, assembly, transfer, unpack, dispatch, or backpressure behavior exists.
findings.impact: The result is a command-calendar width sensitivity, not proof that an aligned 128B or 256B packet can issue in one hardware cycle.
findings.required_action: If reconsidered, create a packet trace and RTL interface with lane-valid, order, alignment, partial-packet, buffering, and downstream backpressure semantics.

findings.finding: The scheduler records metadata occupancy as min(16,len(ready)) and then checks the clamped value <=16, so the underlying ready heap is never bounded by that assertion. CommandPacketCalendar schedules at or after ready_since but may reserve a cycle earlier than current scheduler now.
findings.impact: The model does not prove that a depth-16 metadata/packet queue can physically retain and assemble the descriptors used by the widened calendar.
findings.required_action: Bound the real ready/assembly queue, schedule at max(ready_since,now), and rerun W1 reproduction before any packet-path reconsideration.

findings.finding: W2/W4 receive two/four calendar admissions per cycle with no extra arbitration, register, wire, decode, timing, area, or energy charge. W2 full packets occur in only 16.73 percent of packet cycles and W4 in 1.13 percent.
findings.impact: A 0.036 percent integrated improvement cannot plausibly justify an unmeasured 128B path, and W4 is already slower before physical costs.
findings.required_action: Do not implement this path for performance; only revive it after a much larger predeclared cycle benefit and an equal-area RTL cost model.

findings.finding: Record order and descriptor count are conserved structurally, but the raw result emits no per-cycle descriptor IDs or packet membership. W1/W2/W4 also share the same transformed-scheduler SHA because width behavior lives in a closure class outside that transformed string.
findings.impact: Packet identity, lane order, partial-packet membership, and independent replay of packet cycles cannot be checked from the sealed raw result.
findings.required_action: Emit a canonical per-cycle issue trace with descriptor IDs, ready/current cycle, packet lane, valid mask, and exact source/class identity.

findings.finding: The experiment is restricted to forty records from ten H67 ep35 valid825-internal windows and four expensive Conv3x3 operators, without RTL, accuracy, sequence-disjoint evaluation, or full-network composition.
findings.impact: No general, accuracy-preserving, full-network, system, or DATE claim is available.
findings.required_action: Use sequence-disjoint strata and complete charged-module composition only after a candidate clears the frozen local gates.

findings.finding: Command, response, and parent wait deltas sum to +81264 cycles while non-source overhead rises by +81456, leaving a +192-cycle end/tail residual not named in the receipt.
findings.impact: The total decomposition closes, but the wait-category explanation is not exhaustive.
findings.required_action: Add an explicit calendar-tail/end-drain counter so all integrated-over-source cycles are categorized.

findings.finding: W4 reports total packet cycles and cycles reaching all four lanes, but not separate one-, two-, and three-lane occupancy counts.
findings.impact: Average 29.5 percent utilization is reproducible, but the exact partial-packet shape and packing opportunity are hidden.
findings.required_action: Emit an occupancy histogram for every width.

findings.finding: For ten samples, nearest-rank p95 equals the maximum observation. W2 improves it by only 2656 cycles while two samples regress.
findings.impact: The p95 gate is arithmetically true but weak tail evidence.
findings.required_action: Use more sequence-disjoint, density-stratified windows and retain the no-sample-regression gate.

findings.finding: The r2 log contains progress and one compact marker but no raw-result SHA, exact command, environment, or host identity; the later receipt separately hashes both artifacts.
findings.impact: Current receipt identity is unambiguous, but execution-to-full-output provenance is weaker than an exact-SHA run receipt.
findings.required_action: Have the runner emit the full output SHA and execution environment directly after completion.

next_minimum_direction.name: METADATA_ONLY_BANK_CYCLE_MONOTONIC_K6_GROUPING
next_minimum_direction.selection: Among currently prepared descriptors only, use existing exact bank/delta signature metadata. Accept an alternate K6 group only when its union bank-issue cycles are no greater than the legacy group's cycles; otherwise deterministically use the legacy group.
required_gates: descriptor, DAG, parent and signed-update conservation
no increase in command, response or parent waits
every record and sample source-cycle non-regression
aggregate integrated improvement at least frozen 0.5 percent
next_minimum_direction.rationale: M93 shows the opportunity is in better K6 grouping, while widening admission simply moves stalls downstream. A current-ready, metadata-only monotonic selector targets source-bank work without new packet width, payload storage, or future waiting.
